====Noun====
{{en-noun|~|*|+}}

# {{senseid|en|Q152}} {{lb|en|countable}} A typically [[cold-blooded]] [[vertebrate]] [[animal]] that lives in [[water]], moving with the help of [[fin]]s and breathing with [[gill]]s; any vertebrate that is not a [[tetrapod]].
#: {{hyper|en|vertebrate<id:Q25241>|<|animal<id:Q729>|<|organism<id:Q7239>|<|creature#Noun}}
#: {{ux|en|Salmon is a '''fish'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|The fishmonger sells '''fishes''' from all over the world.}}
#: {{ux|en|Ichthyologists study the '''fish''' of the world.}}
#: {{ux|en|We have many '''fish''' in our aquarium.}}
# {{lb|en|[[cladistically]]}} Any vertebrate, including tetrapods.
# {{lb|en|archaic|or|loosely}} Any animal (or any [[vertebrate]]) that lives exclusively in water.
#* {{quote-text|en|year=1774|author=w:Oliver Goldsmith|title=History of the Earth and Animated Nature|volume=IV|passage=The whale, the limpet, the tortoise and the oyster… as men have been willing to give them all the name of '''fishes''', it is wisest for us to conform.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|title=w:Moby-Dick| year=1851| url=https://books.google.com/books?isbn=0981764479| author=w:Herman Melville| passage=Be it known that, waiving all argument, I take the good old fashioned ground that the whale is a '''fish''', and call upon holy Jonah to back me.}}
#* {{RQ:Hemingway Old Man|page=80|text="What an excellent '''fish''' dolphin is to eat cooked," he said. "And what a miserable '''fish''' raw. I will never go in a boat again without salt or limes."}}
## Now used in combination: (e.g., [[starfish]], [[cuttlefish]], [[jellyfish]], etc).
# {{lb|en|Newfoundland}} [[cod|Cod]]; [[codfish]].
# {{senseid|en|Q600396}} {{lb|en|uncountable}} The [[flesh#Noun|flesh]] of the [[#English:_Q152|fish]] used as food.
#: {{ux|en|The seafood pasta had lots of '''fish''' but not enough pasta.}}
#: {{ux|en|Though Lena is a vegetarian, she doesn't have any problem with eating '''fish'''.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2012|month=March|title=Flexing your brain|journal=Consumer Reports on Health|volume=24|issue=3|page=9|passage=Include low-mercury [[fish]] in your diet (such as salmon) and eat at least five servings a day of fruit and vegetables, especially dark leafy greens, broccoli, and cauliflower. Avoid saturated and trans fats, which may hasten brain aging.}}
# {{lb|en|Roman Catholicism}} An [[aquatic]] or [[semiaquatic]] [[animal]] suitable for [[consumption]] during [[fasting]] on [[Friday]]s during [[Lent]]. 
#* {{quote-web|en|url=https://saintjoachim.net/vatican-corner-04-09-17/|work=Saint Joachim Catholic Church|passage=Since the semi-aquatic beaver was a skilled swimmer, the Church declared it to be a '''fish''' for dietary purposes.|date=2017-04-07|author=sjchurchadmin}}
#* {{quote-web|en|url=https://www.theadvertiser.com/story/news/local/2023/02/20/whats-seafood-for-lent-alligator-beaver-and-armadillo-make-the-cut/69922902007/|work=The Daily Advertiser|passage=Throughout the Catholic Church's long history, archbishops and other prominent church leaders have made numerous declarations about which animals can be considered "'''fish''' for the purposes of Lent, even if those animals have virtually no similarities to fish in a scientific sense.|date=2023-02-20|author=William Taylor Potter}}
#* {{quote-web|en|url=https://www.tastingtable.com/1223413/the-reason-fish-isnt-considered-meat-during-lent/|work=w:Tasting Table|passage=During the 17th and 18th centuries, Catholics around the world began to liberally interpret "fish" as any aquatic-based creature, despite blood temperature, and created local meat exceptions that remain in place today.|date=2023-03-09|author=Jessie Molloy}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} A [[card]] [[game]] in which the [[object]] is to obtain cards in pairs or sets of four (depending on the variation), by asking the other players for cards of a particular [[rank]].
# {{lb|en|countable|slang}} An easy victim for [[swindle|swindling]].
# {{lb|en|countable|poker slang}} A bad [[poker]] player. Compare [[shark]] (a good poker player).
# {{lb|en|countable|nautical}} A [[makeshift]] [[overlapping]] longitudinal brace, originally shaped roughly like a fish, used to temporarily repair or extend a spar or mast of a ship.
# {{lb|en|nautical}} A [[purchase]] used to fish the [[anchor]].
# {{senseid|en|Q165363}} {{lb|en|countable|nautical|military|slang}} A [[torpedo#English:_Q165363|torpedo]] {{gloss|self-propelled explosive device}}.
#* {{quote-text|en|year=1977|author=w:Richard O'Kane|title=Clear the Bridge: The War Patrols of the U.S.S. Tang|page=344|publisher=Ballantine Books|year_published=2003
|passage=The second and third '''fish''' went to the middle of her long superstructure and under her forward deck.}}
#* {{quote-text|en|year=1999|author=John Winton|title=The Submariners: Life in British Submarines 1901-1999|page=114
|passage=As we came off patrol we had some torpedoes fired at us by an enemy submarine but we dived out of the way. About April 10 we fired our '''fish''' in two salvoes at a convoy.}}
# {{lb|en|cartomancy}} The thirty-fourth [[Lenormand]] card.
# {{lb|en|uncountable|slang|sometimes|derogatory|sometimes|positive}} A (feminine) [[woman]].<ref>{{cite-book|1=en|page=145|publisher=David McKay Company, Inc.|location=New York|chapter=8|section=Homosexuals have their own language?|title=Everything you always wanted to know about sex but were too afraid to ask|first=David R.|last=Reuben|lccn=75-94507|year=1969|year_published=1970|text='''FISH''': woman (contemptuously)}}</ref><!--ety: reference to the vagina, cf. tuna taco--> {{q|See also {{m|en|fishy}}.}}
# {{lb|en|prison slang}} A [[new]] (usually [[vulnerable]]) [[prisoner]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=19 Apr 86|journal=Gay Community News|page=4|author=Michael Rathbone|title=Tell Someone|text=When a young male enters the prison system he is looked over and is labeled a '''FISH'''.}}
# {{lb|en|Jamaica|offensive|derogatory}} A [[male]] [[homosexual]]; a [[gay]] [[man]].
#* {{quote-song|en|year=2007|artist=w:Mavado (singer)|album=Gangsta for Life: The Symphony of David Brooks|track=18|title=Touch The Road|passage=Him father is a '''fish''' so mi know say it's sprat dat|t=His father is a '''homosexual''', so I know that he is too.}}

# {{lb|en|LGBTQ slang|sometimes [[problematic]]}} A [[drag queen]] or [[transgender]] woman who looks like a [[cisgender]] woman.
# {{senseid|en|cellular automata}} {{lb|en|cellular automata|rare}} A [[spaceship]].
